latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the finops skill.

- Provides expert guidance aligned to the FinOps framework for cloud financial operations, including cost optimization and business value maximization.
- Covers all major cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, and GCP.
- Details FinOps principles, lifecycle phases (Inform, Optimize, Operate), maturity model, and domains/capabilities.
- Supports core roles: practitioners, engineering, finance, product, procurement, and leadership.
- Explains cost allocation, rate optimization mechanisms, and FinOps maturity assessment.
- Requires access to cloud billing data and cost management tools for implementation.
